channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Meyers Leonard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Meyers Leonard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Josh Shapiro on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
“I was proud of Meyers because that is not an easy choice (to meet with the audience). Living in a cancel culture, there's so much risk in admitting that you've done something wrong. It's almost like you're programmed to try and deny it because one wrong move and your whole life could be over.”

Josh Shapiro on Meyers Leonard, Jun 30, 2023. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Bucks coach Mike Budenholzer vouched for Leonard's character, pointing out the positive steps Leonard has taken since March 2021.

“Meyers has been really, really diligent and conscientious about engaging with the Jewish community, acknowledging that there's no place for antisemitism or antisemitic slurs or any type of hate speech,”

Mike Budenholzer on Meyers Leonard, Feb 23, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike Bass on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Said NBA spokesman Mike Bass:

“Since his use of a derogatory and unacceptable term in 2021, Meyers Leonard has been held accountable and has dedicated considerable time and effort to understand the impact of his comment. He has met with numerous leaders in the Jewish community and participated in community programs to educate himself and use his platform to share his learnings with others.”

Mike Bass on Meyers Leonard, Jan 31, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Erik Spoelstra:

“I want to thank Meyers. I know it's been a long week for him.... We appreciate his time with us.”

Erik Spoelstra on Meyers Leonard, Mar 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Deni Avdija on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Neil Dalal:Deni Avdija on Myers Leonard's comments:

“I don't think Myers had those kinds of intentions. ... I know he is a good dude, he didn't mean to do that and hopefully he understands his mistake.”

Deni Avdija on Meyers Leonard, Mar 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @NeilDalal96.

item.title: Adam Silver on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Shams Charania:Statement from NBA commissioner Adam Silver on Meyers Leonard:

“Meyers Leonard’s comment was inexcusable and hurtful and such an offensive term has no place in the NBA or in our society.”

Adam Silver on Meyers Leonard, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @ShamsCharania.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Scott Brooks on the Meyers Leonard incident:

“Totally unacceptable. I think our players know better... I'm sure the league will do the right thing and address it.”

Scott Brooks on Meyers Leonard, Mar 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Tim Reynolds:Spo on Meyers Leonard's season-ending shoulder surgery:

“If anybody can handle it mentally, emotionally and stay positive, that's Meyers. ... I love the guy. It's a bummer. But he's going to work his ass off.”

Erik Spoelstra on Meyers Leonard, Feb 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @ByTimReynolds.

item.title: Bernie Lee on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
agent Bernie Lee told the Sun Sentinel.

“And then Meyers tweets a picture of it, and the next thing he knows, he has a business. Incredible.”

Bernie Lee on Meyers Leonard, Sep 17, 2020. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Pat Riley on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Pat Riley on Meyers Leonard:

“They are both players who fit the mold of Heat culture perfectly. Meyers is a versatile big, a great shooter, can play inside and block shots.”

Pat Riley on Meyers Leonard, Jul 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
When Kanter picked up his fourth foul early in the third that made way for Leonard.

“Because Enes picked up his fourth early, we got a few more minutes out of [Meyers] and I thought it was just a good time to have him in there… Good things were happening when he was on the court, so we kept him in,”

Terry Stotts on Meyers Leonard, Apr 17, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Meyers Leonard
item.description:
Jay Allen:Stotts on Meyers:

“It was an up & down season, like our team. The biggest thing for Meyers is getting a feel for reacting to the game.”

Terry Stotts on Meyers Leonard, Apr 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @PDXjay.
